entities.name: Otto Müller

entities.summary: Fr. Otto Müller (1870–1944) was a German Roman Catholic priest, active in the Christian Worker's movement and the German Resistance against Adolf Hitler's Nazi regime. Implicated in the July Plot, Müller died in custody in 1944.
